label: WRONG
reason: Actual commands (CreateTenantCommand, GetLayoutCommand extending EnvironmentCommand) are named *Command, but *.command.ts files routinely co-locate nested class-validator payload classes (upsert-preferences.command.ts has 9, upsert-workflow.command.ts 3) plus an exception and a validation shape in base.command.ts, so new nested payload classes would be flagged; only the abstract EnvironmentWithSubscriber base is a real naming slip. Hesitated with ACCEPT if scoped to BaseCommand subclasses.

label: ACCEPT
reason: Route-level components in pages/ are named *Page (AccessDeniedPage, AgentsPage, TopicsPage) even when the file name lacks the suffix; ActivityFeed is a plain page missing it, while the drawers/route handler/TemplateModal are route-mounted variants worth a second look. Biome has no suffix naming rule, so nothing enforces it.

label: WRONG
reason: The main class of each *.service.ts is *Service (CacheService, WorkflowQueueService), but the outliers are co-located error/exception classes (PartialDispatchError, AgentEmailInboxQuotaExceededException) and an abstract health-indicator base that follows the *HealthIndicator family naming, so new co-located error classes would be false alarms. Hesitated with ACCEPT since the service naming itself is consistent.
